notes.title: BIG UPDATE now available
notes.notes:
Hello,

We just finished completely rewriting the graphics/sound/system/code for Hacker Evolution Duality, to fix several reported issues.

The Windows/MacOS update is now availabel on STEAM and it will be shortly followed by the Linux update.

notes.title: MacOS X update available
notes.notes:
Hello,

We have just posted an update for the MacOS X version of the game that fixes several issues that have been reported to us.

Enjoy the game and if there are any further issues, do not hesitate to let us know.

notes.title: Hacker Evolution Duality - DLC and BIG UPDATE are coming
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce that we are betatesting a big update + a DLC package for Hacker Evolution Duality.

If you want to play before the official release, join our forums and send me your username so that I can grant you access to the private forums.

Forum link:

http://www.exosyphen.com/site-forum/
